concept.title: Hiding or Showing Smart Boundaries
concept.shortdesc: Smart fields, smart clauses, read-only fields, and read-only clauses in an agreement document are represented

conbody.p: Smart fields, smart clauses, read-only fields, and read-only clauses in an agreement document are represented in Microsoft Word as a content control, with a bounding box. You can control the visibility of bounding boxes using the Hide Smart Boundary and Show Smart Boundary options.
